Whether you want to talk about the legal system, understand Brazilian culture, dive into history, navigate dating, or even work on personal growth, I’ve got you covered.

1. Brazilian Law
Curious about how laws work in Brazil? I can break down the legal system, help you learn key terms, and even teach you how to talk about legal issues like a pro. It’s perfect for law students, professionals, or anyone interested in politics and governance.

2. Brazilian Culture
Brazilian culture is vibrant and diverse—let’s explore it together! From food and music to traditions and festivals, I’ll help you understand the little things that make Brazilian Portuguese come alive in conversations.

3. Brazilian History
Brazil’s history is full of fascinating stories. I’ll guide you through major events and show you how to talk about them naturally in Portuguese. Whether it’s colonization, independence, or modern-day movements, we’ll make history come to life.

4. Brazilian Dating
If you’re interested in the romantic side of Brazilian culture, I can help you learn the language of dating! From flirting to understanding cultural norms, you’ll feel more confident in expressing yourself and connecting with others.

5. Coaching for Personal Growth
Want to learn Portuguese while working on your goals? As a coach, I can guide you in conversations that not only improve your language but also inspire you to grow. We can talk about self-improvement, meditation, mindset, and achieving your dreams—all in Portuguese!

a) I will send you a very interesting article to read (if the student prefers, if can be a video or even a movie);
b) You’ll be given questions about the article/video to answer;
c) You’ll send back your answers to me before the class so I can correct them and give you written feedback;

b) Lessons of 60 minutes are better, but also 90 minutes are suitable - we could have a 5 minutes break in between - but feel free to pick 30 min or 45 :)
